headline: Executive order puts into action the general terms of a trade deal between the United States and the United Kingdom.
what_it_does: This order carries out the general terms of the US-UK Economic Prosperity Deal, a trade agreement between the two countries. No summary was provided, so the specific changes, such as any adjustments to tariffs or trade rules, cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses that import goods from the United Kingdom
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes to the rules or costs of bringing in British goods, depending on the deal's terms.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses that export goods to the United Kingdom
who_it_affects.how: They may face changed trade terms when selling to British buyers, depending on the deal's details.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 16, 2025; the effective date of specific provisions is not stated in the provided material.
